purpose: Additive assertion functions inside e2e/tests/multi-user-md.property.spec.ts that check post-quiescence invariants across three Playwright pages (pageA1, pageA2, pageB) for the multi-device same-pubkey axis.

public_api.name: assertA15_MD
public_api.signature: async function assertA15_MD(m: ModelStateMD, r: RealSystemMD): Promise<void>
public_api.description: Multi-device same-pubkey self-converge: asserts task sets, members, epoch, and per-pubkey leaf counts are equal between A1 and A2. Skip-guard: !m.groupId || !(m.membersA1 && m.membersA2).

public_api.name: assertC0_MD
public_api.signature: async function assertC0_MD(m: ModelStateMD, r: RealSystemMD): Promise<void>
public_api.description: Three-way C0: extends assertC0 to three pages (A1, A2, B). Asserts four dimensions across all pages. Skip-guard: requires all three to be members.

public_api.name: assertS5_MD
public_api.signature: async function assertS5_MD(m: ModelStateMD, r: RealSystemMD): Promise<void>
public_api.description: Biconditional (p in members) iff (leafCount >= 1) for pubkeyA and pubkeyB, scoped to m.groupId. Expected pubkeyA leaf count is 2 when both A1 and A2 are attached.

public_api.name: assertS6_MD
public_api.description: Model-only monotonicity: epochSequenceA1, epochSequenceA2, and epochSequenceB must each be non-decreasing.

public_api.name: assertS10_MD
public_api.signature: async function assertS10_MD(m: ModelStateMD, r: RealSystemMD): Promise<void>
public_api.description: DeviceList row count on pageA1 and pageA2 each equals getPubkeyLeafCountHook(page, groupId, pubkeyA). Skip-guard: !m.groupId || !m.pubkeyA.
